# CookMyTech
> Premier AI & Full-Stack Software Engineering Studio

CookMyTech is a specialized software engineering studio building production-grade web applications, autonomous AI agents, enterprise RAG systems, Next.js web applications, and multi-tenant SaaS architectures for startups, founders, and growing enterprises.

## Primary Services
- [AI Software Development](https://www.cookmytech.com/services/ai-software-development): Production AI software engineering, predictive pipelines, intelligent APIs.
- [AI Application Development](https://www.cookmytech.com/services/ai-application-development): Custom AI web tools, intelligent decision support apps, embedded ML.
- [AI Chatbot Development](https://www.cookmytech.com/services/ai-chatbot-development): Multi-channel conversational AI assistants, customer support agents, tool execution.
- [AI Agent Development](https://www.cookmytech.com/services/ai-agent-development): Autonomous multi-agent orchestration, LangGraph deterministic loops, tool calling.
- [RAG Systems Development](https://www.cookmytech.com/services/rag-development): Retrieval-Augmented Generation, vector embeddings (Pinecone/pgvector), document intelligence.
- [LLM Integration](https://www.cookmytech.com/services/llm-integration): Enterprise LLM connections (OpenAI, Claude, Llama 3), semantic caching, prompt guardrails.
- [Custom Software Development](https://www.cookmytech.com/services/custom-software-development): High-concurrency business software, portals, APIs.
- [Next.js Development](https://www.cookmytech.com/services/nextjs-development): High-speed SSR/SSG Next.js 16 App Router apps optimized for sub-100ms TTFB.
- [SaaS Development](https://www.cookmytech.com/services/saas-development): Multi-tenant architecture, Stripe billing, role-based access control.

## Regional Engineering Hubs
- [Noida](https://www.cookmytech.com/locations/noida): Sector 62 & Expressway Corridor, Uttar Pradesh.
- [Greater Noida](https://www.cookmytech.com/locations/greater-noida): Knowledge Park & Pari Chowk Industrial Hub.
- [Delhi NCR](https://www.cookmytech.com/locations/delhi-ncr): National Capital Region (Noida, Gurgaon, Delhi).
- [India](https://www.cookmytech.com/locations/india): Pan-India Enterprise & Remote Delivery.

## Core Guarantees & Operating Model
- Senior-only developer execution (no junior handoffs).
- 48-hour first code commit SLA after sprint onboarding.
- 100% intellectual property and source code ownership transferred to the client.
- Fixed-scope sprint estimates with zero hidden agency markup.
